description:
Get a World Bank indicator for a country.
Popular: NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP), SP.DYN.LE00.IN (life expectancy), SH.XPD.CHEX.PC.CD (health spend/capita), SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS (unemployment)

country.description: ISO2 code: US, GB, DE, JP, CN. Default: US

date_range.description: Year range: '2015:2024' or single year '2024'. Default: last 10 years

name: wb_indicator
